title: 新传考研 AI 批改助手 · AI Grading Assistant
description: An independent product that grades journalism postgraduate entrance-exam essays. It decomposes 9 question types into 8 assessment dimensions, compares real grading runs against human scores to locate systematic bias, and iterates the prompt output from there — built, launched and marketed solo, now at 500+ users with early revenue.

title: 3D Personal Workbench
description: A room built in Blender, with camera moves, hotspots and content panels driven by React Three Fiber and GSAP. It is both a personal archive and a career path you can explore.
